surfaces.name: Hey Fish voice tab button
surfaces.summary: Raised 3rd tab-bar button (index.html:129). Its .tb-lbl reads 'Hey Fish' or 'Listening'. States: idle (green), listening (Voice.on: red and pulsing), awake (9 s command window: blue and still pulsing), unsupported (class has no CSS). It is never .active. There is NO voice overlay; voice state shows only on this button and through toasts, speech and First Mate chat bubbles.

engineApi.name: supported
engineApi.description: Feature-detected once at load: !!(SpeechRecognition||webkitSpeechRecognition). Gates the toggle (unsupported â†’ toast + toggle the First Mate panel).

engineApi.name: on
engineApi.description: Mic session believed live. Drives the red/pulse styling and the 'Listening' label. Set false while the app is hidden. bite.js speaks alerts instead of toasting while on.

engineApi.name: wantOn
engineApi.description: User intent; survives backgrounding. The SW update gate uses on||wantOn.

engineApi.name: awake
engineApi.description: Wake word heard; a 9 s command window (blue button).

engineApi.name: resumePending
engineApi.description: Optional, new: localStorage fishapp.voice==='on' and waiting for the first tap. The old UI showed only a toast.

engineApi.name: init
engineApi.description: Call once after the assistant init. Sets the initial UI, and when fishapp.voice==='on' registers a one-shot capture-phase pointerdown resume (skipping taps on the mic button) and toasts 'Tap anywhere to resume hands-free'.

engineApi.name: toggle
engineApi.description: Mic button handler. Must run synchronously inside the user gesture: unlockAudio, requestWakeLock, start the recogniser, persist on/off, toast, and speak 'Hands free on. Say hey fish when you need me.'

engineApi.name: stop
engineApi.description: Full stop: wantOn=false, on=false, abort the recogniser, clear timers, refresh the UI, then applyPendingUpdate(). Does not write localStorage.

engineApi.name: say
engineApi.description: Speak text and set the echo guard (_muteUntil = now+1200+len*60; speaking for 600 ms). Used by the bite.js weather watch.

engineApi.name: extendMuteUntil / setMuteUntil
engineApi.description: Replaces assistant.js's direct writes to Voice._muteUntil: max() extension for the device TTS estimate; exact set to the real cloud audio duration+700 ms and to now+700 on device onend.

engineApi.name: isBusy
engineApi.description: on||wantOn. The service-worker update deferral must not reload while true.

engineApi.name: handleTranscript / run
engineApi.description: Test hooks: wake-word gate, then ordered command dispatch with question routing and the First Mate fallthrough.

engineApi.name: host.panels/toast/assistant.send/spots.create/nav/tracks/goto/map
engineApi.description: Side effects emitted through an injected VoiceHost interface (it replaces the window[fnName] and typeof-global lookups).

engineApi.name: KNOTS / KnotArt
engineApi.description: Static knot data and per-knot SVG frame strings, rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Also used by the First Mate knot answers (steps).

engineApi.name: FISH_ID / CDFW_URL
engineApi.description: Static species, size and bag data plus the official regs URL. Also used by First Mate regs answers and the online prompt.

engineApi.name: guidesTab / expandedKnots / expandedFish
engineApi.description: Session-lifetime UI state (selected tab defaults to knots; expanded sets default empty) so the old 'built once' persistence survives panel close and reopen.

engineApi.name: fishTipsFor / areaTipsFor / techniqueTipsFor
engineApi.description: Order-dependent matchers over FISH_TIPS, AREA_TIPS and TECHNIQUE_TIPS, used by the assistant engine (including skipping geocoding for species names).

fish-id.js:48-49 The Fish & Limits CDFW disclaimer and official link must stay first and always visible, verbatim; species notes carry legal cautions (rockfish depth closures, WSB seasonal 1-fish window, HMS federal rules).

assistant.js:1416 + bite.js:521 EXISTING HAZARD: voiceSay goes through asstSpeak, which is silent when First Mate speech is muted (the default), so command confirmations AND weather alerts while Voice.on are neither spoken nor toasted. Needs an owner decision.
voice.js:141-153 'where am I' and speed readouts do not check gpsIsStale and speak a stale position as current; keep the formatCoord VHF format.
risks: voiceCall uses window[fnName]; in ES modules routeStart, gotoCancel and anchorRaise are not on window, so a naive port makes those voice commands reply 'I can't do that right now.' Use an injected VoiceHost.

voiceCall reports success whenever the function does not throw: 'Starting the route.' with fewer than 2 points, 'Navigation stopped.' even if the user cancels the confirm(), 'Anchor up.' with no watch. Preserve it, or fix with sign-off.
The track voice rule is a pure toggle: 'start tracking' while recording stops it, 'stop track' while idle starts it, and 'Track saved.' is said even when a too-short track is discarded.
'when's the bite' is unreachable because voiceNorm turns the apostrophe into a space; 'fish id'/'limits' opens Guides on the last-used tab, not Fish & Limits.
React StrictMode or effects could double-register the visibilitychange and capture-phase pointerdown listeners; keep them in a module-level singleton.
If the mic button loses id='btn-voice' (or an equivalent guard), the relaunch resume plus the toggle double-fire turns voice off on the first tap.
Calling voice.toggle from an effect or async boundary instead of synchronously in the click loses the iOS user-gesture unlock (mic, audio, anchor alarm sound).

iOS WKWebView shell (fishapp:// scheme): SpeechRecognition may be absent or flaky; mic and speech-recognition usage strings are needed in Info.plist; target=_blank CDFW links need native handling to open externally; localStorage on the custom-scheme origin is separate from GitHub Pages (the fishapp.voice preference does not carry over). Not verifiable from the web repo.

knot-diagrams L()/Tg() ignore width arguments (FG frame 2 and Non-Slip frame 2 render at width 4, not 3/3.5); a JSX rewrite must match the rendered output, not the apparent intent. Snapshot-test the strings.
'Surgeonâ€™s Knot' uses U+2019 in both KNOTS and KnotArt; normalising the apostrophe in one place silently drops its diagrams.

fish-tips matchers are order-dependent with known mismatches ('spotted sand bass' â†’ Barred Sand Bass; 'dropper' â†’ Carolina rig; generic aka words like 'cow' and 'goat' suppress geocoding of places in assistant.js:1034); reordering the data changes First Mate answers.
localStorage reads and writes in voiceToggle/voiceInit are not try/caught; if storage throws, wantOn can be stuck true without a session (blocking SW updates).
Expanded and collapsed state of the knots and fish accordions persists for the session only because the DOM is built once; React component-local state would reset it on panel close.
